Upload

Start with what you have

The records that show a payment mistake already exist, spread across your accounting system, your bank, and a few spreadsheets.
Export them the way you normally would and add them to Reclaim: bills, invoices, payment history, vendor credits. Reclaim lines the files up against each other, so a payment in one export can be matched to a bill in another. No integration project, and no new process for your team.

Find

Only what the records show

Most payment mistakes aren't hidden. They're buried: two payments for one invoice, or a credit that was never applied.
Reclaim checks every payment against the bills, invoices, and credits around it. It looks for duplicate payments, duplicate bills, overpayments, unused credits, and payments that don't match what was billed. You get a short list of findings, not a long list of maybes, each with the amount involved.

Evidence

Proof behind every finding

A finding is only useful if you can check it. Every result in Reclaim comes with the records behind it.
Open a finding and see the bill, the payments, the dates, and the amounts, with the details that match called out. Each record points back to the file and row it came from. You decide whether it's a real mistake, so a finding never rests on a guess.

FAQ

  • What records can I upload?

    Bills, invoices, payment history, vendor-credit reports, and accounting exports, as CSV files. Our export guides show where to find them in common accounting tools.

  • Do I need to connect my accounting system?

    No. You can start with files you export yourself. Nothing needs to be installed or connected to get started.

  • What does Reclaim look for?

    Duplicate payments, duplicate bills, overpayments, unused vendor credits, and payments that don't match what was billed. Each one has its own section on What It Checks, with examples.

  • How does Reclaim decide something is a mistake?

    It compares records against each other: vendors, amounts, invoice numbers, dates, and references. A finding is raised when the records themselves show the problem, and every finding lists the records it is based on.

  • Can a finding turn out to be fine?

    Yes. A partial payment, a deposit, or a credit applied outside your export can look like a mistake. That's why every finding shows its records, and why you review it before treating it as one.

  • Which accounting tools does it work with?

    Reclaim works from exported records, so it isn't tied to one tool. We have export guides for QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, and Bill.

  • How are my files handled?

    Our Security page covers how Reclaim handles the files you upload.

  • Who is Reclaim for?

    Businesses that pay a lot of vendors, without a team to chase every mistake: finance and AP teams, operators, and founders.
